rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjectival way to mean pertaining to the Olympic Games, as in 奧運嘅火炬.

example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 hai6 ou3 wan6 ge3 fo2 geoi6

rows.note: Use this specifically for something made to Olympic specifications or size, such as an Olympic-standard swimming pool.

example.english: This swimming pool is Olympic standard.
example.traditional: 呢個泳池係奧運規格嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 wing6 ci4 hai6 ou3 wan6 gwai1 gaak3 ge3
